text: SPoS imposes a dual penalty that reduces financial stake and reputation at the same time, amplifying accountability by combining immediate tangible cost with long-term social consequence inside the validator community.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Cryptographic Foundations and Interdisciplinary Dimensions of the Secure Proof of Stake (SPoS) Conse (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5225296

isBasedOn.name: Cryptographic Foundations and Interdisciplinary Dimensions of the Secure Proof of Stake (SPoS) Conse

abstract: When combined with slashing, which simultaneously reduces both financial stake and reputation—a dual penalty unique to SPoS—this mechanism amplifies accountability by imposing immediate tangible costs and long-term social consequences within the validator community
